name: tensioner-pawl
title: Tensioner: the pawl
description: A leaf pawl whose square tip meets the ratchet's teeth: it bends over each tooth as the spool winds in and holds it from unwinding.

length.rule: Long enough to lift a tooth's height (1.5 mm) at 0.9% strain

thick.rule: Six lines: it holds the spool end-on, as a column (85 N to buckle free-ended, against 50 N at the rim for a 100 N strap); three lines buckled at 11 N
